# GAO open-recommendations export excerpt

`open-recs-2026-09-28-excerpt.csv` is SpicyDocs' fixture of the same name
(`tests/fixtures/gao_recommendations/`, 32,751 bytes, SHA-256
`d6c0fc5bff6b17638ad9cd13015cbd714d3cc6131507aa636041985bf8eef4da`): GAO's
export of 2026-09-28 cut to its preamble, header and 26 records, byte for byte.
Its README lists why each record was kept. Ten records state a director phone
(seven distinct values), which is what the phone tests look for. U.S.
government work, public domain.
